Original JUCE Rename Wavetable action changes the display name while preserving every sample. Unicode rename, cancellation, patch save and persistence through page reload pass with audio inactive and running. This does not claim new rename undo behavior.
Original JUCE refresh action discovers a newly added user WT file, keeps the current name and sample data unchanged, and makes the new category/table selectable with exact sample restoration.

The original oscillator wavetable context-menu command opens and closes the JUCE script editor without replacing the current table. This review covers this entry point; the broader scripting workflows remain separately evidenced.

Original oscillator context submenu exposes WT, WAV and individual-frame export; Serum and VCV Rack entries appear only for scripted tables. All five routes reach their browser pickers and preserve the selected table.

The original oscillator menu exports compatible floating-point WT samples and dimensions through the selected browser handle, including native filename-extension normalization. Script metadata, cancellation, picker lifetime and failure recovery are additionally exercised through the shared script-editor export implementation.

The original oscillator menu exports mono float WAV samples, dimensions and script metadata without changing the selected table. Shared export tests verify headers, picker lifetime and retained data after failures.

The original oscillator menu exports every generated frame into the selected browser directory. Shared frame-export tests verify compatible WAV samples, naming collisions, preservation of existing files and recovery after interrupted writes.

For scripted tables, the original oscillator submenu exports a 2048-sample-per-frame WAV with Serum clm metadata and embedded Lua metadata. Sample comparisons and current-table preservation pass; the command remains hidden for non-scripted tables.
